settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A detailed scale model of a university campus - buildings, sports facilities, roads and landscaping - presented on a branded base under a clear case. A prestigious centrepiece for receptions, alumni events and open days.

settings.s1_body: A campus model captures the whole institution in one prestigious piece. We reproduce buildings, sports grounds, roads and landscaping to scale, finished on a branded base under a clear case. Ideal as a reception centrepiece, an open-day and alumni showpiece, or a commemorative gift marking a partnership or milestone.
